notes.title: The latest in the "Atelier" series, “Atelier Resleriana” is now free-to-play!
notes.content:
Adventure, Alchemy, Everyday

KOEI TECMO GAMES and Akatsuki Games present the latest title in the Atelier series!
A story of the two protagonists Resna and Valeria, and the simple yet profound game system of gathering, synthesis, and battle. Plus, encounter many characters from past Atelier games.

For new starters only! Two of the highest rated ★3 characters (Rorona + another character) are guaranteed!

Begin your alchemy adventure by playing this free-to-play game now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2594920/

Official Site：https://resleriana.atelier.games/en

Official X：https://twitter.com/Resleriana_EN

©KOEI TECMO GAMES / Akatsuki Games Inc.

notes.title: Update Ver1.02（2021/06/22 ）
notes.content:
The following updates have been applied.
---------------------------------------------------------------
・Adjusted Palmyra of Genesis to get stronger proportionately to the number of times she is defeated.
・Other minor adjustments and fixes.

notes.title: Update Ver1.01（2021/05/17 ）
notes.content:
The following updates have been applied.
---------------------------------------------------------------
Adjusted frame rate specifications.
Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when attempting to view the "High-speed Levitation" effect for Toydozer in the Encyclopedia.
Added a warning message regarding accessing the photo mode when you play as you download.
Other minor adjustments and fixes.

notes.title: Notice of known issues
